lines.text: &fLand you own in the shop world. A plot is a claimed area that other players cannot build in, break in, or take from.
&7The picture is the plot area seen from above, with every plot tinted by what it means for you:
&aGreen&7 - for sale and you can afford it. &eYellow&7 - for sale, but too expensive for you. &9Blue&7 - yours. &cRed&7 - owned by someone else and not for sale.
&7Click a plot to select it &8- the panel on the right shows its price, its owner, and what you can do with it.
&7Select a green plot and press &fBuy plot&7. The price is taken in Starcoins straight away and the land is yours from that moment.
&7Plots get pricier &6the more you already own&7 &8- the price in the panel is always your own price, already counted.
&7A plot marked &fResale from&7 a player is theirs, put up for sale. Buying it works the same way.

&7On your own plot, type a &fResale price&7 and press &fPut up for sale&7. That price is what you receive when someone buys it. Change it with &fUpdate price&7, or take the plot back with &fRemove from sale&7.
&fSell to the server&7 refunds the plot's base price shown on the button &8- not what you paid for it&7. It asks you to confirm, because &cit cannot be undone and everything built there is lost&7.
&7Clear out what you want to keep &fbefore&7 selling.
&8The map updates live: if someone buys a plot while you are looking, its colour changes.
